primary.notes: UR58A and UR58B appear to be two parts of a once much larger khipu containing some 106 cords (58 + 48 = 106).

cords.name: p5s1s1s1
cords.notes: This cord has two knot clusters.  The first single knot in the second cluster has brown (MB) thread run-through.

cords.name: p7s1s1s1
cords.notes: This cord has two knot clusters.  The second 1E knot has light brown (AB) thread wrapped around it.

cords.name: p10s5
cords.notes: This cord is knotted with cord 10s6 at 26.5 cm.

cords.name: p10s6
cords.notes: This cord is knotted with cord 10s5 at 26.5 cm.

cords.name: p11s1
cords.notes: This cord has two knot clusters.  The second single S knot has red thread tied through it.

cords.name: p45
cords.notes: Cord 45 is knotted onto the primary cord (for example, not in a half-hitch knot).

cords.name: p46
cords.notes: This cord has two knot clusters.  The second 1E knot in the second cluster has black (LK) thread run-through.

cords.name: p47
cords.notes: Cord 47 terminates in a bundle of short strings (15 - 20 cm) tied together by cord 47.  There are no knots on these strings.
